SYMPTOM: Subject dropdown in SendPackageModal was empty when opened by org admin — no subjects loaded.

CAUSE: fetchSubjects used `.eq('tutor_id', user.id)` — fetching subjects for the logged-in user (org admin) who isn't a tutor and has no subjects.

FIX: Added `tutorId` prop to SendPackageModal. CompanyStudents passes `student.tutor_id` when opening the modal. fetchSubjects and handleSubmit use `propTutorId ?? user.id`.

PREVENT: Any org admin modal that deals with tutor-owned data (subjects, sessions, packages) must receive the relevant tutor's ID as a prop — don't assume `user.id` is the tutor.
